opening.argument: The video presents a flash-loan arbitrage tool as a path to a rapid, substantial return, directing viewers through wallet connection, stated charges, and a deposit-and-execution workflow. It identifies a “contract deployment fee” of 0.05 BNB, a swapping fee of 0.36 BNB, gas of 0.41 BNB, and an estimated profit of 4.7437 BNB. The viewer is told to connect MetaMask, deposit, confirm, execute, and confirm again, while the displayed form shows a 72 BNB loan and the same estimated return. Although the final wallet screen and narration declare success, they do not document an actual flash-loan trade or establish the provenance of any payout. The payment and deposit steps are therefore presented as the gateway to an impressive return without substantiated evidence that the return was realized.

citations.quote: The contract deployment fee is 0.05 BNB. Swapping fee is 0.36 BNB. Gas fee is 0.41 BNB and the loan estimated profit or ROI is 4.7437 BNB.
After choosing the loan amount, click connect to Metamask, then wait until notification.
To do this, just click deposit. And click confirm.
The next step is click execute. And click confirm.
